BEAMNG LIVERY DESIGNER
======================
1. Double-click LiveryDesigner.html. It opens in your web browser (Chrome,
   Edge or Firefox) and runs on your computer. No internet needed and
   nothing to install.
2. Drag the vehicle's .zip file into the app:
     - modded vehicles: from your BeamNG mods folder
       (launcher > Manage User Folder > Open in Explorer > mods)
     - the game's own vehicles: from
       Steam\steamapps\common\BeamNG.drive\content\vehicles
   The app finds the vehicle's template, paint and Paint Design slot by itself.
3. Design your livery: mark the two sides, then add text, stripes, shapes,
   paint and logos.
4. Click "Make mod file". The new file goes to your Downloads folder.
   Drag it into your mods folder (for a modded vehicle, replace the old file).
5. In the game: Vehicle Config (Ctrl+W) > Parts > Paint Design > your livery.

To change words that are already on a livery (like the name on a delivery
truck): pick that livery from the Template list, choose the "Change existing
words" tool (X) and drag a box around the words. Type the new words.

To change it later, drag the file you made back into the app. Your design
comes back, ready to edit.

Full step-by-step help: the "Guide" button in the app, or GUIDE.html.

Reading words uses Tesseract / tesseract.js (Apache License 2.0); see the
LICENSE-tesseract files.
